"""Slug generation utilities."""

import re
import unicodedata

__all__ = ["slugify"]

_NON_SLUG_CHARS = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9]+")
_SEPARATORS = re.compile(r"-+")


def _to_ascii(text: str) -> str:
    """Transliterate accented Latin letters and drop everything non-ASCII."""
    decomposed = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
    return decomposed.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")


def slugify(text: str, max_length: int = 64) -> str:
    """Convert text to a URL-safe slug.

    The result is lowercase ASCII containing only ``a-z``, ``0-9`` and single
    hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen.

    :raises ValueError: if ``text`` holds no slug-able characters.
    """
    ascii_text = _to_ascii(text).lower()
    slug = _SEPARATORS.sub("-", _NON_SLUG_CHARS.sub(" ", ascii_text)).strip("-")
    if not slug:
        raise ValueError(f"cannot slugify {text!r}: no slug-able characters")

    if max_length > 0:
        slug = slug[:max_length].rstrip("-")
    return slug
